items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Solomon asked God for wisdom. And Solomon was really a brilliant... He was a brilliant man.

ctx.x: Yeah. It certainly couldn't do anybody any harm, and it certainly did some wonderful... You mentioned something about Solomon, too, didn't you.

Yes. I'll always remember that... You know, Solomon asked God for wisdom. And Solomon was really a brilliant... He was a brilliant man. And I wanted to quote that, and I had to look up the verse that comes near to saying that. He said, 'Wisdom is the principal thing. Therefore, get wisdom, and with all you are getting, get understanding.' Which is important in music. Anything you go into, get to understanding what makes it work. And I... It's important to read that whole...read it from the first chapter to the…
